title: Pina Bonita | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoors, a fully fenced private oasis delivers nonstop enjoyment with a sparkling pool, shaded lounge areas, patio dining, and an impressive lineup of games including a putting green, ping pong, foosball, and more. Three comfortable bedrooms provide restful retreats after sun-filled days, making this home ideal for families and groups alike. Conveniently located near Old Town Scottsdale, golf courses, and top attractions, this playful yet polished escape offers a refreshing blend of comfort, fun, and desert sunshine.
